response.text:
I can do that, but clearing or deleting mail is a destructive action so I need a couple quick confirmations first.

Please tell me:
1) Do you want to delete those messages (move to Trash — permanently removed after 30 days), permanently delete them now, or just archive them (remove from Inbox but keep in All Mail)?
2) Match criteria — do you mean every message with the sender containing "uber" (this will catch Uber, Uber Eats, Uber Freight, etc.), or only a specific Uber address (for example no-reply@uber.com)?  
3) Do you want this applied to your entire mailbox (all folders) or only Inbox?  
4) Would you like a preview first (I can show a short sample or a count of matched messages) before I perform the action?

Reply with your choices (1–4). I will not change anything until you confirm.
